summary: The web test's depth sample on an NFO option: a dk carrying the quote beside the book (OHLC, volume, average price, trade quantity, book totals, OI as oi, circuits, the ltt clock) becomes a Depth frame with every one of them and AliceBlue's order counts; a df that changes the price and the first ask's quantity keeps every other field and level.

notes: Inputs of web test/test_aliceblue_quote_feed.py (marketcalls/openalgo#2473, de8456ab3): test_depth_ack_publishes_quote_fields_and_orders and test_depth_diff_merges_per_level_and_field.
AliceBlue's ltt (HH:MM:SS) goes out as last_trade_time, as the web passes it on; ltt is the feed time ft on both sides.

deviations.reason: The web sends AliceBlue's feed time ft as ltt in epoch seconds, an integer since web #2473 (aliceblue_adapter.py `_feed_time`, `_quote_fields`); the docs key ltt is epoch milliseconds (docs/prompt/websockets-format.md).

The web's Depth timestamp is AliceBlue's feed time ft in epoch seconds (aliceblue_adapter.py `_on_data_received`, web #2473); the frame timestamp is epoch milliseconds (docs/prompt/websockets-format.md), and the desktop sends its receipt time.
